grouping_check_scope: Every audited step, all slots and environments: exact validity, leader, count, force and moment against the original serial kernel. Research controls are excluded from primary timing.
phase_profile_scope: Intrusive synchronized dispatch plus device execution in audited repeat zero; samples exclude first 60 steps. Primary inclusive scene timing uses uninstrumented repeats. Same-substep native geometry, Hertz pressure, witnessed finite-footprint transfer, original wrench and actual-facet friction acceptance, coarse P2 elastic recovery and max/full output. Rejected observations are NaN and excluded from admitted throughput while the rigid diagnostic rollout continues. Proportional shear has no friction memory; coarse fields lack Hertz near-field enrichment. These timings do not qualify physical shell stress accuracy or a usable public estimator.
